headline: On November 4, 2010: Qantas A380 Survives Engine Failure
captionCards: Debris from Qantas Flight 32 fell on houses in Batam.
The incident led to improved engine safety standards.
instagramCaption:
Qantas Flight 32 faced a critical engine failure. \\[Qantas Flight 32, an Airbus A380, suffered an uncontained engine failure over Indonesia shortly after taking off from Singapore. The crew managed to safely return to Singapore, saving all 469 passengers and crew. Debris from the aircraft fell onto houses in Batam, but no injuries occurred. This event highlighted the importance of rigorous safety protocols and skilled pilots. \\Why do you think this flight's safe landing is still celebrated? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
